records.description: Secure your organization’s AI posture without breaking the user experience. We use Privacy Twins—not redaction—to replace sensitive data with synthetic context, ensuring LLMs give 100% accurate results. Includes full audit logs and governance tools to manage Shadow AI.

records.name: SiteGEO.ai
records.tagline: Is AI Recommending Your Business?
records.description: Protect your AI Reputation. Optimize for ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. SiteGEO.ai is the professional diagnostic suite for AI Search Visibility and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).

records.name: PTA Tax Calculator
records.tagline: Calculate Pakistan mobile import taxes in seconds
records.description: When you bring a smartphone to Pakistan, you must register it with PTA (Pakistan Telecommunication Authority) and pay import taxes within 60 days—or your device gets blocked. The problem? Tax calculations are confusing, with rates varying from 18% to 47%. PTA Tax Calculator solves this by providing instant, accurate tax calculations for any mobile device.

records.name: Qwen3-TTS
records.tagline: Voice design, cloning & 97ms streaming
records.description: A family of SOTA speech models (0.6B & 1.7B) supporting 10 languages. Features prompt-based Voice Design, 3s zero-shot cloning, and extreme low-latency streaming.

records.name: Krisp Mobile Call Recorder
records.tagline: Record outgoing calls and get transcripts + AI notes
records.description: Your phone calls now fit naturally into your meeting workflow. Place outgoing calls from the Krisp mobile app and Krisp automatically records and transcribes the conversation. Right after the call, you get AI-generated notes with a concise summary, key points, and clear action items. The call is saved as a structured Krisp Note and synced across mobile and desktop. Currently available for US numbers, with expanded coverage planned over time.

records.name: PayPing
records.tagline: All your recurring payments in one place
records.description: Track renewals, get reminders, view analytics in beautiful dashboards, and use AI to optimize your subscription spending. Discord Bot, Chrome Extension. Email forwarding receipts. Also manage your credit card bills; when I said you can manage all recurring things: I meant it.

records.name: Multi-Scene Video generator
records.tagline: Create character and voice consistent long videos at scale.
records.description: A true multi-scene, character-consistent video generation platform built to craft compelling stories from simple prompts. Create ads, talking videos, AI avatars, music videos, or scenes without being an expert in prompt engineering or juggling 10+ tools.

records.name: UPDF 2.0 for iOS
records.tagline: Full-power PDF editing & AI chat for iPhone/iPad.
records.description: Finally, a pro-grade PDF editor for iPhone & iPad. Edit text directly, chat with AI to summarize 50-page docs, and convert files on the go. Scan to PDF with OCR, sign contracts, and manage Zips in one secure hub. No more desktop limits. 🚀

records.name: Edge Light for video calls
records.tagline: Browser extension to look good on video calls.
records.description: Does the lighting in your room feel like crap? And does it make you look like you are attending meetings from a cave? Then edge light is for you. A well lit face is essential to looking good. Edge Light adds a soft ring light to your browser so your face stays brighter and clearer during video calls without any extra hardware. You can tweak brightness, intensity or color that suits your skin tone.

records.name: ussmm.com
records.tagline: Buy Verified Wise Accounts
records.description: Buy Verified Wise Accounts from us Our accounts are verified, Phone number, Residential address, Utility bill, passport, Valid driver s license SSN Whatsapp:- +1 (484)790-1487

records.name: Threat Road
records.tagline: Free vulnerability database that publishes fresh CVEs daily
records.description: Threat Road is a free vulnerability database that publishes fresh CVE data every single day. - No middleman. - No delays. - No paywalls.

records.name: DRS Solution OLM to PDF Converter
records.tagline: The smartest way to convert OLM files to PDF format.
records.description: Effortlessly migrate Mac Outlook data with our OLM to PDF Converter. This powerful tool ensures every email, contact, and attachment is accurately transitioned into a universally accessible PDF format. Maintain your folder structure and metadata integrity with a streamlined, secure process. Perfect for legal discovery, business archiving, and easy document sharing—bridge the gap between OLM and PDF today.

records.name: fdsrch (prod)
records.tagline: Food search, simplified.
records.description: fdsrch takes an ingredient-first approach to food search. Instead of relying on nutrition scores or vague dietary tags, it parses and normalizes ingredient lists so you can search and compare foods based on what’s actually in them. It’s built for clarity, not conclusions.

records.name: Roam FM
records.tagline: Roam the world by tuning into global radio stations
records.description: Turn live radio from 40,000+ stations into your ambient background sound. Roam into a random corner of the world in real time, right in your macOS menu bar.

records.name: Procure Suite
records.tagline: Robust Procurement Platform to Streamline Purchasing Process
records.description: Procure Suite is a feature-rich, cloud-native procurement platform engineered to cut purchasing costs by 18-40% for modern enterprises. There are multiple platforms for managing reverse auctions, RFP/RFI/RFQ, contracts, procure-to-pay, and purchase requisitions. Manufacturing, healthcare, construction, biotech, and other core industry sectors can streamline sourcing lifecycle, manage contracts, and gain total spend visibility—all from one intuitive dashboard. Modernize your supply chain today.

records.name: Cosplay AI APP
records.tagline: Any anime and video character cosplay AI APP
records.description: Generate stunning cosplay images of anime and video gamecharacters with AI. Define the character, pose, scene, and body figure to create realistic cosplay photos.

records.name: Tonkotsu
records.tagline: Manage a team of coding agents from a doc
records.description: Tonkotsu is a fresh approach: a clean, focused GUI that lets you manage a team of coding agents from a doc. FREE during our early access program.

records.name: MAIVE: AI Music Video Generator
records.tagline: Generate AI Videos of any length! Add your audio.
records.description: Generate AI Videos of any length! Add your audio. Generate real AI videos, not animated images. Turn words into AI Videos! Easily showcase your new song, audio, podcast or music by easily making AI music videos! Generate an AI Video and we'll notify you when it's done. No waiting with the app open. All AI Videos are stored on your device for future viewing.

records.name: μBarometer
records.tagline: Simple, useful and nice barometer for Android
records.description: A simple barometer for monitoring atmospheric pressure. The goal of μBarometer is to be useful, small and elegant. Features: - Pressure units: mBar, mmHg, inHg, atm - Altitude units: meters, feet - Pressure Graph: mini graph, detailed graph, widget and notification - Altitude Indicator - App widget with three themes - Pressure value in the status bar - Data sources: a built-in sensor, the Internet

records.name: Journaling App
records.tagline: Journal smarter: cards, prompts, AI coaching – all private
records.description: Journaling App is a free Chrome extension for quick self-reflection with AI coaching. Each 2-7 minute session follows a simple flow: choose your goal (Clarity, Calm, or Action), draw a metaphorical card for inspiration, write using proven techniques like RAIN, GROW, or WOOP, get AI coaching questions to go deeper, and end with an insight plus an actionable next step. Your journal stays 100% private – all entries stored locally in your browser. Start your first session in seconds.

records.name: Astro Day
records.tagline: Calm daily astrology without predictions
records.description: Personal horoscope by date of birth with a calm daily emotional indicator.

records.name: 1Setter
records.tagline: One-click system settings for macOS
records.description: 1Setter is a lightweight macOS menu bar app that lets you control system settings with a single click. Quickly toggle features like hidden files, Dock behavior, and other system options—without opening System Settings.

records.name: nlsh
records.tagline: talk to your terminal in natural language
records.description: A terminal interface that translates plain English into shell commands. Stop memorizing flags. Just type what you want.

records.name: DharmikGuide - Divine Partner Platform
records.tagline: Marketplace for pandits, astrologers , influencers & yatras
records.description: DharmikGuide by DharmikVibes is a partner-first platform building India’s trusted spiritual ecosystem. Discover and book verified pandits, astrologers, spiritual gurus, temple guides, yatras, stays (ashrams/retreats/homestays), transport, and dharmik creators. Structured services, transparent pricing, and on-ground support make every spiritual experience seamless and authentic.

records.name: Preloop
records.tagline: The MCP Governance Layer
records.description: AI agents are powerful, but one wrong action could be catastrophic. Preloop is an agentic automation platform with built-in human approval layer. AI agents automate routine work across your systems, and when they attempt risky actions (deployments, refunds, data changes), Preloop intercepts and routes them for approval via mobile, Slack, or Teams before execution. You can use Preloop for automation only, approval gates only, or both together depending on your needs.

records.name: Conthunt
records.tagline: Content Intelligence: Aggregate & Analyze Viral Videos Fast
records.description: Conthunt is a content intelligence platform that aggregates short-form videos from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube. Delegate AI agents for frame-by-frame analysis, virality scoring, and instant marketing decks. Our agentic search decomposes queries into smart keywords for superior results, the fluid canvas boosts productivity without disruptions. Built for marketers, social managers, and eComm pros—slash research time, amplify content automation, and turn viral video data into competitive advantage.

records.name: DropTidy
records.tagline: Remove sensitive photo data, 100% client-side & zero uploads
records.description: Do you know what data your photos reveal about you? 🤔 Every image you share contains hidden metadata exposing your exact location, daily schedule, and technical details that can fingerprint your device. Whether you’re a photographer or privacy-conscious, you need to be aware of this risk. DropTidy lets you delete this data in your browser. 🔒 Total Privacy: Everything happens inside your browser. 🕵️ Deep Analysis: Find hidden privacy risks. ✨ Lossless: Keeps original quality and resolution.

records.name: Forge Agent
records.tagline: Swarm Agents That Turn Slow PyTorch Into Fast GPU Kernels
records.description: Forge turns PyTorch models into optimized CUDA and Triton kernels automatically. 32 AI agents run in parallel, each trying different optimization strategies like tensor cores, memory coalescing, and kernel fusion. A judge validates every kernel for correctness before benchmarking. We got 5x faster inference than torch.compile on Llama 3.1 8B and 4x on Qwen 2.5 7B. Works on any PyTorch model. Free trial on one kernel. Full credit refund if we don't beat torch.compile.

records.name: Startupily
records.tagline: Strategic assets and AI tools to build and lead startups.
records.description: Startupily: The executive engine for founders. Strategic assets, financial models, and documentation to build and lead with precision.

records.name: QubiSales
records.tagline: Turn Chats into Sales. Automatically
records.description: QubiSales provides WhatsApp Business API solution to automate messaging, run bulk campaigns, build chatbots, and manage customer conversations at scale.

records.name: ImageMerger.io
records.tagline: Turn product photos into marketplace-ready assets in seconds
records.description: POV: you’re building a brand or shop, but don’t have a studio budget. ImageMerger uses AI to turn basic product photos into professional e-commerce images in seconds. Upload a photo, pick a style, get two ready-to-use images: one white background, one themed. Perfect for Amazon, Etsy, Shopify and more. No subscriptions. Credits never expire. Results in under 30 seconds.

records.name: Brújula Security
records.tagline: Free crypto anti-phishing protector. No ads, no tracking.
records.description: Brújula Security is a lightweight browser extension built to protect crypto users from phishing and malicious sites. It operates with a strict "zero-tracking" policy, collecting no user data. I'm hunting this because it recently flagged a fraud site faster than a paid antivirus. It’s completely free, ad-free, and provides a transparent safety layer for your Web3 navigation.

records.name: LessontoStory.com
records.tagline: Turn academic curriculums into interactive stories with AI
records.description: LessontoStory is an EdTech solution designed to bridge the gap between rigid academic content and student engagement. Our AI-powered engine transforms complex textbooks and curriculums into compelling, interactive narratives, helping students retain information up to 70% better through storytelling. Key Features: 📖 Instant Text-to-Story Conversion 🧠 AI-Driven Narrative Engine 🌍 Multi-Language Support 🎓 Perfect for Schools, LMS, and Content Creators.

records.name: TheMangaTranslator
records.tagline: Where AI meets manga - breaking language barriers
records.description: TheMangaTranslator: Professional AI manga translation. Take a page from any language and translate it to any target language. Our system automatically detects the source language and uses advanced translation models to ensure natural, accurate results in 40+ languages. Complete interface makes translation accessible to everyone. Automatic detection, intelligent reconstruction, contextual translation, professional typesetting and built-in editor so you don't need to launch photoshop. Free trial

records.name: CaliberMind Agentic Analytics Agent Cal
records.tagline: Deterministic AI for Marketing Analytics | Trusted, Governed
records.description: Agent Cal is the first deterministic AI agent for GTM Intelligence and marketing analytics designed to accurately answer any GTM or marketing question—from campaign performance & channel optimization to complex pipeline trends. It is: Audit-Proof: Provides "itemized receipts" (SQL) to verify the logic behind the answers. Built on Trust: Unlike probabilistic AI, it writes precise code against your unique business rules. Context-Aware: It understands your specific funnels and account hierarchies.

records.name: Kite - AI Project Management Made Simple
records.tagline: AI-powered project management designed for startups.
records.description: Project management has become too complicated. Kite brings simplicity back. Built specifically for early-stage startups and creative teams, Kite uses AI to transform how you plan and execute projects. Describe your idea and watch AI create complete project structures with checkpoints, tasks, and realistic timelines. No overwhelming dashboards, no endless menus—just what you need to keep your team aligned and productive. Beautiful design you'll love opening every morning.

records.name: wdgt.pro
records.tagline: Discover real-world app widgets
records.description: The world’s largest app widget design reference library.

records.name: Year Designed
records.tagline: Design your year. Structure beats inspiration.
records.description: A free digital planning tool based on Daniel Pink's workbook, with frameworks from Tim Ferriss and Chris Williamson. The process: identity snapshot, past year review, pre-mortem (identify how you'll fail before you do), friction design, and a theme word for the year. When you're done: download your plan, set calendar reminders for reviews, get an AI wallpaper, and export to Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini/Grok as an accountability partner. No account. Fully private. Data stays in your browser.
